note: Token-discipline dimension. The Task Recorder has one read-only tool, so the lever is not filtering but tool CHOICE within the service: taskrecorder_to_markdown (~3 KB and ~7 KB for the two fixtures) answers every question here; taskrecorder_to_document is 12 KB of structuredContent plus a 9 KB .mhtml written to disk, and is never the right call for a fact question. Ceilings are measured x 1.5.

1.lever: two taskrecorder_to_markdown calls, one per file; never taskrecorder_to_document

4.lever: same two conversions; the Data Sources table is in the markdown, no KB call needed

7.lever: same two conversions; the BPM role table is in the markdown, no Sec call needed
